context: A couple shares a quiet, honest evening conversation
purpose: Teach: 幼児/こころ/叫び/貧しい/筈/云々/前者/師匠

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、今日アルバムを見てたら、幼児の頃のあなたの写真があってね、思わず笑っちゃった。
lines.en: Hey, I was looking through the album today and found a photo of you as a small child—I couldn't help but laugh.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate, warm chuckle in her voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うわ、恥ずかしいやつ見つけたな。あれ、母さんが捨てた筈なんだけど、まだ残ってたんだ。
lines.en: Ugh, you found the embarrassing one. Mom was supposed to have thrown those out, but I guess one survived.
lines.style: Sheepish, lightly groaning but amused, distinct timbre that anchors the scene

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 捨てるなんてとんでもない。あの泣き叫び顔、こころから可愛いと思ったよ。
lines.en: Throw them out? No way. That crying, wailing face—from the bottom of my heart I thought it was adorable.
lines.style: Tender protest, voice softening with quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとう…正直に言うとさ、うち、当時かなり貧しい時期だったんだ。両親が必死で働いてくれてた。
lines.en: Thanks… To be honest, we were pretty poor back then. My parents were working themselves to the bone.
lines.style: Quieter, opening up with real vulnerability.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そう…話してくれて嬉しい。お金があったかどうか云々より、ご両親が頑張ってた事実の方がずっと大事だよ。
lines.en: I see… I'm glad you told me. Whether there was money or not matters far less than the fact that your parents kept going.
lines.style: Gentle, choosing each word slowly with care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 父さんが料理人の師匠について修行してた時期でね、給料は安かったけど、夢は譲らなかった人なんだ。
lines.en: Dad was apprenticing under a master chef back then—the pay was awful, but he never gave up on his dream.
lines.style: Reflective, with quiet nostalgic pride creeping in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夢と家族、前者を諦めずに後者も守り抜いた…お父さん、本当に強い人だね。
lines.en: Dreams and family—he never gave up the former and still protected the latter… your dad is really a strong person.
lines.style: Admiring tone, gently squeezing his hand softly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 両方守ったって言ってくれて救われるよ。今夜、君にこの話できて、なんか肩の荷が下りた気がする。
lines.en: Hearing you say he protected both really saves me. Telling you this tonight—I feel like a weight just lifted off me.
lines.style: Settled, quietly grateful closing tone, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty
